evals.prompt: Make a landing page for our product Wordhive, it's a flashcard app for learning words. Look at what's in the repo and in memory, ask me questions if something's critical.
evals.expected_output: A fact base from code/docs and a brief with sources; up to 4 critical questions; the core mechanic in one sentence; a section map where every form is justified by a Wordhive fact; a signature moment derived from the product's mechanic; one HTML file, checked at 1440 and 375.
expectations: The brief contains the core mechanic sentence in the format "A person does ___, and ___ happens"
The section map has a column with a product fact for every form
There is no pinned horizontal process panorama unless there is a fact about a long branching process in Wordhive
There is no comparison table with repeated "You" chips unless there is a fact that the value is taking work off the person
The signature moment is derived from Wordhive's core mechanic and falls apart if you swap in a product from another category

evals.prompt: we already have a landing in proposals/landing but the positioning is fuzzy, tons of features and no story. repackage it: do some research, rework the vision and give me a new section structure before you start drawing anything
evals.expected_output: Discovery with no drawing: features grouped along an axis chosen from the product's facts; one central idea; 2–3 headline options; an updated brief and section map with a question and a fact for every section; open questions.

evals.prompt: Landing is done, I'm happy with it. Deploy it to vercel and hook the early birds form up to supabase so I can see the emails.
evals.expected_output: build.sh without the version switcher, OG/favicon, vercel project add/link/deploy --prod, curl check; an insert-only migration with column grants and unique lower(email); a client form with states; curl probes of permissions and deletion of test rows; a link to the table in the dashboard.

evals.prompt: Need a landing for InvoiceLens, it's an API that pulls structured data out of PDF invoices (vendor, totals, VAT, line items) for devs building accounting services. Free tier for 100 documents, paid after that. No repo, don't ask me questions, just go with defaults. Give me only the brief, section map and design plan, no HTML.
evals.expected_output: A brief and section map that account for a developer audience and a familiar category; a signature moment and devices from the product's own world; pricing with the free tier; no forms from the case studies without a matching fact.
expectations: The signature moment shows the InvoiceLens mechanic itself, not a canvas, monitors or a mood scene from the case studies
There is a pricing section or block with the free tier of 100 documents; there is no waitlist form
There is no name acronym, feature wall or pinned horizontal diagram unless a fact explains it
A monospace font is planned for code, because the audience is developers
Every section in the map has an InvoiceLens fact in the justification column
